name: likelyfad-prompt-system
description: Agent-loadable prompt skills for producing content with AI models.

plugins.name: ai-ugc
plugins.description: Turn a script + reference images into ready-to-paste realistic UGC talking-head video-ad prompts. Current model: Google Gemini Omni (swappable).

plugins.name: ai-animation
plugins.description: Turn a finished script + already-made images (character, scene, product) into ready-to-paste animated video-ad prompts (Pixar/Disney 3D), including beat-cut music videos (finished song + SRT) and sung lip-sync jingles. Current model: ByteDance Seedance 2.0 image-to-video (swappable).
